behavioral_effects: None stated. An empty list is a claim that nothing observably changes.
compatibility_impact: None. Grep over frontend/src finds no reference to leaflet in any module; the bun.lock diff is pure removals, no remaining version specifier changed, and the package.json re-ordering is bun re-sorting dependency blocks alphabetically, a formatting effect only. frontend-test (lint, type-check, vitest) passed after removal.
reason: The 2026-08-11 debt sweep (commit 749587b) deleted map-message.tsx and map-leaflet.tsx, the only consumers of leaflet, react-leaflet, and @types/leaflet; the packages remained in frontend/package.json only because the bun remove stalled on network resolution and was deferred, so the dependency list overstated the frontend's real surface
rollback: Revert the commit; package.json and bun.lock return to their pre-removal state and bun install restores the three packages.
security_impact: None. The three packages had zero importers since commit 749587b deleted map-message.tsx and map-leaflet.tsx, their only consumers; removal shrinks the frontend dependency surface and drops the leaflet, @react-leaflet/core, and @types/geojson transitive trees from the lockfile.
summary: Remove unused leaflet, react-leaflet, and @types/leaflet from frontend dependencies
